terms.context: A single note the user adds to or edits on a block
terms.notes: Capitalized as a German noun (die Notiz). Plural Notizen.

terms.context: A paragraph, heading, list item, table row, code block or note that a note attaches to
terms.notes: Same word as English, capitalized as a German noun (der Block).

terms.context: "The notes list" section heading and prose — the panel listing every note in the file
Bottom bar showing confirmation messages such as "Note added"
Top bar holding the File/Edit/View/Notes/Help menus
"Using a screen reader" section heading and prose (JAWS, NVDA, etc.)
terms.notes: Kept as one German loanword, capitalized (der Screenreader), not translated as "Bildschirmleser".

terms.context: The note markers, e.g. [usernote]/[/usernote]; "changing the markers hides existing notes"
terms.notes: Plural Markierungen; the pair is Anfangsmarkierung / Endmarkierung, as in the settings, never "öffnende" or "schließende Markierung". Markierung only ever means a note marker: a text selection is "markieren" (verb) or "Auswahl", never "Markierung".

terms.context: A Markdown checklist item; "Mark this task as done?"
terms.notes: Capitalized as a German noun (die Aufgabe).

terms.context: The "Document language" setting, which sets the screen-reader voice and legacy-encoding detection for the open file
terms.notes: One compound word, capitalized as the setting name (die Dokumentsprache).

terms.context: The "Interface language" setting, which sets the language of menus, dialogs and messages
terms.notes: One compound word, capitalized as the setting name (die Oberflächensprache).

terms.context: Generic word for a dialog box, e.g. the Add note dialog or the standard Windows Open dialog
terms.notes: Same word as English, capitalized as a German noun (der Dialog).

terms.context: The confirmation dialog buttons, e.g. "Delete this note?" answered with Yes or No
Windows File Explorer, e.g. dragging a Markdown file onto the PlanCake window
terms.notes: Hyphenated in the German manual's rendering of this Windows UI element name.

terms.context: The Windows Downloads folder where PlanCake saves a plan downloaded from a link
terms.notes: "in Ihrem Ordner Downloads", with the folder name in bold like other interface names and no quotes; never "Windows-Ordner Downloads". Downloads stays untranslated: it is the real Windows folder name.

terms.context: The Windows Start menu, used to launch PlanCake
The Windows Command Prompt (cmd.exe), as distinct from PowerShell which stays untranslated
terms.notes: Windows' own localized name for this app; PowerShell is left in Latin script per repo convention.

terms.context: File Explorer's "Copy as path" command, which puts a quoted file path on the clipboard
A GitHub issue; "Paste them into a new issue on PlanCake's GitHub page"
terms.notes: Kept as an English loanword, capitalized as a German noun (ein neues Issue), not translated as "Fehlermeldung" or "Ticket".

terms.context: GitHub's "Raw" link/button for viewing a file's raw content
terms.notes: Left untranslated, matching GitHub's own (unlocalized) button label.
